comment: Track P Stage S (SFT) protocol, host-independent (spec §3.4, §3.6, §4, §6.1; R1-TRACKP-SFT-DEV, 17 Nov 2026). Host values (bases, GPU, micro-batch, lease) come from the host config passed as --config: trackp_portal.json for TASL-2 / TASL-7, trackp_htcondor_v2.json for HTCondor GPUs on image v2 (R1-QTORCH-AMEND). AI-assisted (Claude); ENGINEERING_ONLY config.
authority: R1-TRACKP-SFT-DEV (author-decisions-20261117b @ 45fb94cc): build and try the SFT pipeline now on sweep 1's c3_features/v3 + trackp_prompt/v2 table (ENGINEERING); plug in sweep-1 B.2's label block when it exists; outputs not used for any evidence, selection or tuning; the 7006-7010 evaluation block is never read; train directly once sweep 2's labels exist.

sweep1_v3.pin_comment: proposals.jsonl and configs.json are the data and are pinned; build.json records paths and the build commit, so it differs between rebuilds and is recorded, not pinned. A local rebuild with this branch's code (main 26177d82 + mac-w2-v3-rebuild-20261115 merged as 47e50b22, with the refactored dataset.sweep_replay_inputs) reproduced both pinned hashes exactly.

sources.sweep1: label_block.jsonl of the sweep-1 B.2 evidence audit (r1.c3.audit evidence-run), with its evidence_completion.json; full verify_evidence_completion run separately
sources.sweep2: label_block.jsonl of the sweep-2 B.2 audit (R1-SWEEP2-B2-DRAFT), same format; --label-sweep sweep2 with the sweep-2 table

splits.cross_split_duplicates_comment: R1-TRACKP-SFT-DUP (author, 17 Nov 2026): every train row kept; primary held-out results exclude proposals whose (node, incumbent, candidate) also occurs in the training data (val rows seen on a train instance; test proposals seen on a train or val instance); secondary results use the full held-out populations (val + val_seen rows; every test proposal).
splits.comment: PRE-SPLIT A of the signed sweep-2 analysis preregistration (R1-SWEEP2-PREREG): P3 is the only evidence split, for every arm and both sources. The P3 split file (T0: per node 9 test / 3 dev / 6 train of the 18 design instances by sha256('c3_p3_split/v1:' + instance); T1: G5-SPLIT 6 / 2 / 4) is the assignment and the universe; dev is the builder's val. It replaces trackp_sft/v1 (salt trackp_sft/v1, 3 test / 3 val / 12 train per node), whose earlier engineering uses are to be disclosed in the arms-frozen record (not yet written).

train.comment: Spec §6.1 and §4 (R1-LR-GRID, R1-TOKEN-INIT, R1-TEMPERATURE). loss: rps+ce (primary), ce (the §6.1 CE-only ablation), rps (extra). micro_batch here is the default; the host config's sft.micro_batch overrides it (effective batch stays 16); any other host sft key must agree with this block.
